summary.whatChanges: Changes how the generated llms.txt table-of-contents file is built: doc links now use each doc's permalink (respecting custom slug frontmatter) instead of the file-path-based id, are emitted as absolute URLs prefixed with the site URL, and the file now begins with an H1 heading.
behaviorChanges: Links in the generated llms.txt are absolute (site URL prefixed) rather than site-relative paths.
Docs with custom `slug` frontmatter now link to their real permalink instead of an id-derived path.
The llms.txt content starts with an H1 (`# <title>`) line that was previously plain text.
risks: If siteConfig.url is undefined or misconfigured, links become malformed (e.g. 'undefined/docs/...').
The slash-deduplication regex only runs on the non-http branch, so permalinks already starting with 'http' bypass normalization.
Consumers that previously parsed relative paths from llms.txt will now receive absolute URLs.
